items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Did you know his brother Horace?

ctx.x: No, no, no, I mean the other bands.
Yeah, something like that. That's the most, if that -- any more than two keys. Fletcher, he'd write some mean stuff. I may have asked you this. Did you know his brother Horace?
I just know of him. I've never met him.
